title: Handle ledger — SHAPE ONLY. The ORDERING rule ((-sizeKm, contentHash), total, dense) is G-ORDER's business and is asserted by the gate against a recomputed digest, never duplicated here.

handle.description: THE handle grammar, and it is identical in content/schemas/landform-instance.schema.json. 4-6 hex, not exactly 6: the grammar is Plan B's committed one and a stricter {6} here would hard-reject a handle another venue considers valid. mintHandle emits a uniform SIX hex (HANDLE_HEX = 6) because any scheme whose length depends on the bucket can renumber an existing handle when a later instance arrives — STATE §13 — but that is the WRITER's rule, not the grammar's.
